description: Validate FlowZap Code syntax. Use this to check if FlowZap Code is valid before creating a playground.

code.description: FlowZap Code to validate. Common shortcuts accepted: 'n1 -> n2' (handles auto-inferred) and 'n1 --> n2' (normalized). Full syntax: n1.handle(right) -> n2.handle(left).

name: flowzap_validate
